_comment: Edit prompts or model settings here, then run generate.py. Model names and input keys change on Replicate: check replicate.com before running.
style: stylized low-poly 3D game character, flat-shaded facets, simple clean shapes, soft studio lighting, full body, side three-quarter view, centred, plain light grey background, no shadow, no text
